notes:
A CORRECTION, NOT A NEW ADJUDICATION. sqlite DCL06-C labels carried forward from delta-adjudication-task757-r720-weekend, delta-adjudication-task757-round181, delta-adjudication-task757-round182, delta-adjudication-task757-round183, delta-adjudication-task757-round184, delta-adjudication-task757-round2, which predate the 2026-10-07 rulings, re-read under them: src/util.c through src/wal.c in file order.

RULING. rulings/rules/DCL06-C.md: the oracle labels strict (P/oracle-scope); strict is the presumption with no exempt set (DCL06-C/2026-10-07/form, /presets); EX1 applies only where the constant is itself the abstraction; an array dimension in a declaration is FP after CERT's own sizeof compliant solution, with the violation at dependent uses (P/lists case 3). This is the reading calibrated in delta-dcl06c-2026-10-curl-mbedtls-sqlite and applied in the later 2026-10 DCL06-C batches. A changed reading relabels: the earlier FPs rested on domain-standard, algorithm-inherent, self-evident or comment-documented values, spec constants or no stated basis, none of which the presumption admits; the earlier TPs on declaration dimensions predate P/lists case 3.

SCOPE. Every carried-forward TP or FP DCL06-C row in these files. 3 keys with the literal in a preprocessor condition (src/util.c:1623, src/util.c:1627, src/vdbe.c:1828) are held and left as they are, pending the separate question of literals in preprocessor conditionals. 30 of the rows are not reported by aurora-lint ca6fd5f3f and are labeled on their merits, as the provenance says.

METHOD. Every row was read at source at the pinned commit (corpus-check: sqlite at its pin) by a reader under a written brief, against a mechanical draft (declaration dimension, const-qualified initializer, preprocessor condition, otherwise the presumption), and reviewed. A fresh-context reviewer re-read a stratified sample.

RESULT. 145 rows reviewed: FP->TP 100, TP->FP 2, FP kept 5 and TP kept 38 with their reasons restated. FP bases: array dimensions in declarations 4, EX1 3.

Mechanics: in-place edits keep each key; the original batch takes a row_count decrement and a superseded_rows record. Counting basis: distinct (project, commit, file, line, rule) keys. No precision claim is made here.
